answer: A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The cedar counter is kept in cipher and prism makes public each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2862 identities would post 2390 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
